protocol.depth: FixedR4 only. No adaptive quality claim.
protocol.evidence_boundary: Controlled API E2E. Native request metrics are separate. Memory allocation is not HBM traffic. No new placement speedup.
protocol.input_policy: Two frozen 8192-token patterns. Truncate or repeat each pattern to the declared length. Synthetic long-context hardware workload.
protocol.kv_pool_ownership: Divide the52GiB aggregate native KV pool evenly across TP ranks. TP1/TP2/TP4 allocate52/26/13GiB per rank.
protocol.memory_boundary: The52GiB aggregate native KV pool covers the audited Base2.6B C1 request including native null blocks. Activation and workspace safety still require the run.
protocol.output_policy: Native greedy sampler with one allowed non-EOS token, shared across all cells.
protocol.purpose: Native C1 context scaling and capacity preflight. Not a candidate engine or natural task quality.
